text:
Sam: Quick follow-up from the incident-447 postmortem. Need owners + timelines for: statuspage copy, customer-facing summary, RCA sharing policy, and remediation ticket owners. Also want a cadence for tracking recurring patterns. Who can take what?

Elaine: I can own status page language. Will draft a short, non-technical update and a follow-up note for when the RCA is available. Draft in 24h, publish in 48h after legal OK. Will drop draft in the incident doc.

Maria: I'll own customer summaries for affected accounts and enterprise outreach. Need status page text first to avoid mixed messaging. Initial summary within 6h of publish, account-specific follow-ups within 24h.

Devin: Question for the group: publish full RCA or redacted? Product favors transparency, but legal/ops may require redactions. Propose redaction policy: strip internal IPs, vendor debug snippets, and exact guardrail thresholds if they enable abuse.

Jordan: Legal needs to review customer-facing RCA content. I'll loop legal in and confirm whether full RCA can be published or if we need a redacted version + process for providing full RCA to contractual customers. Will confirm within 12h.

ops-bot: <automated> Postmortem page created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/incident-447/postmortem
ops-bot: <automated> Tracking ticket RD-4567 created for follow-ups. Assignee: unassigned.

Elaine: Proposed status page template to keep things simple and safe:
> We experienced elevated inference latency affecting a subset of requests between 02:10–02:43 UTC. The issue has been mitigated and normal service resumed. We are investigating the root cause and will publish a follow-up with details and remediation steps within 72 hours.
I can shorten it further if legal requests. Will add a non-sensitive "what we're doing" bullet list (canary checks, patch rollout).

Maria: That reads well. I'll append: "Customers may request additional briefings; contact your account team." Keeps the door open for enterprise conversations.

Devin: From the postmortem action items we need owners for the following tickets:
- RD-4568: Fix KV cache eviction edge-case -> owner?
- RD-4569: Long-tail latency dashboards & alerts -> owner?
- RD-4570: Improve fallback routing rules -> owner?
- RD-4571: Run recurring stress tests to find patterns -> owner?

Sam: I'll take RD-4568. ETA: code change in 3 business days, staging rollout 2 days after, prod rollout in 7 days pending canary.

Jordan: I'll take RD-4571. Plan: weekly stress test for 6 weeks, interim summary at week 4, final at week 6.

Elaine: I'll take RD-4569. Dashboards by EOW, alert runbook by next Tue.

Devin: I'll take RD-4570. Prototype fallback rules in 5 business days; need sync with infra to validate.

Maria: I've added a support playbook snippet and linked it to RD-4569. Will tag AMs once status page is live.

Sam: Need fast decision on RCA distribution so we can finish status page line about "RCA availability." Jordan/legal to confirm in 12h, Elaine will finalize copy after that.

Jordan: Legal looped in (cc @legal-team). Expect reply within 8–12h.

Sam: Action summary (I will track):
- Elaine: status page draft (24h), publish (48h) dependent on legal
- Maria: customer summaries & playbook (6h after publish)
- Sam: RD-4568 fix & rollout (3/2/7 days)
- Elaine: RD-4569 dashboards & alerts (EOW / next Tue)
- Devin: RD-4570 fallback prototype (5 business days)
- Jordan: RD-4571 stress test cadence (weekly x6)
- Jordan/Legal: confirm RCA policy (12h)

Sam: I'll create a recurring 15m weekly slot for pattern review and an async tracker in the incident doc. Please update RD-4567 with owners + ETAs as you confirm. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: <automated> Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 48h. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/incident-447/tracker

Maria: Acknowledge. Will coordinate enterprise comms once status page is live.

Elaine: Updating draft now, will ping for quick review. Thanks everyone.
